name: memail_list
description: List cached messages, newest first. Optional filters: `account` (a mailbox id from memail_accounts — omit to span all mailboxes), `mailbox` (folder name, default INBOX), `unread` ('true' to show only unread), and `limit` (default 50, max 200). For paging older mail, pass `before` = the `sent_at` of the last message you saw (UTC ISO-8601) to get the next page. Returns { messages: [{ id (UUID), account_id, thread_id, from_addr, from_name, subject, snippet, sent_at, is_unread, has_attachments }] } — a lightweight summary with NO body. Use memail_get for a message's full body, or memail_search to find by keyword instead of listing.

account.description: Optional mailbox id (from memail_accounts) to limit to one account. Omit for all.

unread.description: Optional: 'true' to return only unread messages. Omit for all.

before.description: Optional keyset cursor: return messages strictly older than this sent_at (UTC ISO-8601). Use the last message's sent_at to page.
